verdicts.reason: The two candidates use almost the same layout and share the same flaws. The shoe circle is shrunk and pushed down into the bottom-left corner, so it no longer reads as the hero. 'Full review inside.' floats on its own to the right of the circle with nothing to anchor it, and the bottom-right area is left empty. The only difference is spacing: A's headline sits too low, so the gap above it to the logo row is loose while the circle crowds it from below (about 45px). B puts the headline higher, which spaces the logo, headline and circle a little more evenly.
